blocks.intro: On July 11 and 12, 2017, more than 7 inches of rain fell just south of Elgin, and basements flooded across the area.

items.body: A line that's half full of roots has half the capacity when a storm hits. Clearing it ahead of time gives it a fighting chance.
Service before spring, when roots start growing again and heavy rain arrives.
If you have a backflow valve or an [overhead sewer system](/elgin/overhead-sewer-systems), we'll make sure it works during the same visit.

blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/elgin/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/elgin/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/elgin/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/elgin/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/elgin/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: How do I know if my Elgin sewer line needs a maintenance plan?
items.preview: A history of backups, a clay line or big trees nearby.
items.answer: If your line has backed up before, is clay, or runs near large trees, a plan makes sense. A camera inspection tells us how often your line actually needs attention.

items.preview: Rodding for roots, jetting for grease and scale.
items.answer: Rodding cuts roots back quickly and is usually enough for yearly root control. Jetting cleans the whole pipe wall and is better for grease, scale or roots that return fast.

items.q: Will maintenance keep the basement dry in a big storm?
items.preview: It helps your line drain, but it can't stop an overloaded sewer.
items.answer: A clean line carries water out as fast as it can, which helps. When the public sewer is overloaded, you also need protection like a backflow valve or an [overhead sewer system](/elgin/overhead-sewer-systems).

items.q: Does the No Drip Club include sewer work?
items.preview: It includes regular maintenance visits. Ask how it applies to your line.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club/) brings a plumber to your home for regular maintenance. Ask us how it applies to your sewer line.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether your line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check, and on access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
